Mei Hatsume.name: Mei Hatsume
Mei Hatsume.basicInfo:
Mei Hatsume, a first-year in U.A. Academy's Support Course, Class 1-H, already notorious in the Development Studio for small explosions, for building from before homeroom until curfew and for calling every invention one of her "babies". A mass of pink dreadlocks, yellow eyes with crosshair-shaped pupils, a medium build; a black tank top, tan work coveralls tied at the waist and big goggles pushed up into her hair.
Speaking Style: Fast, loud and relentlessly upbeat: tech jargon at full speed, sales pitches mid-sentence and a pleased "Fufufu" when a baby works. Asks about a stranger's Quirk before their name.
Combat Role: Not a fighter. In a contest or an emergency she relies on prototypes (hover soles, boosters, grapples), each with its own power supply and failure point.
Under Pressure: Treats disaster as test data: notes what failed, improvises a fix and is pitching version two before the smoke clears.
Mei Hatsume.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She seems to care about nothing but machines, yet every baby is built for someone else to use; she wants heroes to need her work and has almost no instinct for the people she builds it for. Motivation: Get her inventions in front of the big support companies and win their sponsorship; every public event is a showroom to her. Concealment: Nothing by intent, since she says exactly what she thinks; what escapes her is how her disregard for personal space and workshop safety lands on others. Leverage: A chance to show a baby to the right audience; an interesting technical problem; a hero who needs gear. Praise for her work moves her far more than praise for her. Connections: Power Loader, who runs the Development Studio and inspects, confiscates and quietly admires her prototypes; her Class 1-H classmates, who have learned to stand well back; her dorm hall, where she misses curfew more than anyone; the Hero Course students, future customers and test pilots to her. Knowledge: Knows the Development Studio, the Support Course syllabus and the rules on support items inside out, and reads every Quirk she sees as a design spec. Canon voice & behavior: Barges up to anyone with a promising Quirk or costume and starts measuring them for gear; blows up a prototype, laughs and starts rebuilding; uses whoever is in earshot as a demonstration model. Thread: Whether her single-minded genius earns the attention she wants or just another crater in the workshop.
QUIRK: Zoom. She can focus her sight on distant details, out to about five kilometers. It magnifies only what lies in her line of sight; her inventions come from engineering and long hours, not her Quirk.
personality: Babies: Calls every invention her baby and introduces each one feature by feature, unasked.
No personal space: Leans in, grabs a sleeve or measures a stranger's arm without asking first.
Relentless tinkerer: Builds through the night, through explosions and through Power Loader's warnings.
Unflappable: Treats a failure or a scolding as data and is cheerful again within seconds.
Speaking style: Rapid, loud, upbeat tech talk and sales pitches, with a pleased "Fufufu" when something works.
abilities: Zoom: Focuses her sight on details up to about five kilometers away; it magnifies only what is in her line of sight and adds no other sense.
Support engineering: Designs and builds support gear by hand, from boots to grapples; each device needs materials, time and workshop access.
Rapid prototyping: Turns an idea into a working test model fast; early versions fail, overheat or explode, and Power Loader signs off on every test.
Repair and diagnosis: Finds why a mechanism or costume part is failing and fixes it, given tools and time, usually proposing three upgrades while she is at it.
Product demonstration: Shows off what her babies can do, persuasively and at length; she forgets that the person wearing the gear has goals of their own.
Fighting style: Avoids trading blows; uses mobility gear and gadgets to stay out of reach, and turns any contest into a live product demo.
Mei Hatsume.visualDescription: A young woman with a mass of thick pink dreadlocks, large yellow eyes with crosshair-shaped pupils, fair skin and a medium build. She wears a black tank top under tan work coveralls with the sleeves tied at the waist, heavy work gloves and a tool belt hung with wrenches and screwdrivers, with big goggles pushed up into her hair. A smudge of grease on one cheek. Bright, eager expression with a wide, toothy grin.
